text: 1.Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2.Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3.Certificate/Diploma of highest educationThe certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized4.ResumeWritten in Chinese and English You can download a template or sample from here 5.Health CertificatePhotocopy of physical examination record.
